errors.what: First clan read used a relative path while the shell cwd was not the repo root, so doc.clan was not found
errors.recovered_by: cd to the absolute repo root before each command and re-running

problems_and_friction: Shell cwd resets between calls and did not match the orchestrator-stated cwd, so relative paths failed until I anchored to the absolute repo root. The rep5 doc was already populated from a prior run, so the market_* merge-patch was effectively idempotent.
context_understood: First analyst in a CRM-recommendation chain for Brightline Logistics, merge-patching market_* findings (TAM, segment, growth, incumbent share, buyer priorities) into the shared CLAN doc for the next pricing analyst.
